title: I made a free idle RPG you play in your browser
author: Johan0251
selftext:
Hi! I've been building Lampwick on my own for a while and it's finally at a point where I'd love other people to play it.



It's an idle RPG with an old ink-and-paper look. You pick one of 8 callings and 8 kin, then make your way down the coast, zone by zone, from the fen to the bottom of the sea. Check in, make your choices, and let your character keep going while you're away.

\- Free, nothing to install: [https://lampwick.org](https://lampwick.org)

\- Works on phone and desktop

\- Lots to discover if you stick with it

I'm one person making this, so honest feedback is very welcome: what you liked, what you'd change, what confused you.



Thanks for taking a look!
